marketplace_creditors_operations_id.title: Marketplace creditor operation identifier
marketplace_creditors_operations_id.description: This field contains the ID of created marketplace creditor operation.

creditor_id.title: Creditor identifier
creditor_id.description: This field contains the creditor identifier related to the creditor operation.

processing_code.title: Processing code
processing_code.description: This field contains the processing code related to the operation.

marketplace_id.title: Marketplace identifier
marketplace_id.description: This field identifies the marketplace related to the operation.

operation_type_id.title: Operation type identifier
operation_type_id.description: This field contains the operation type identifier related to the operation.

installments.title: Number of installments
installments.description: This field contains the number of installments for which this condition applies

network.title: Network
network.description: This field contains the network for which this condition applies

org_id.title: Tenant identifier
org_id.description: This field identifies the tenant responsible for this operation.

mdr.title: MDR percentage
mdr.description: This field identifies the mdr percentage that will be applied to transactions using this condition. Values from 0 to 1

first_installment_days_to_payment.title: Number of days before the first payment
first_installment_days_to_payment.description: This field contains the number of days between the purchase and the first payment. It will be applied for transactions that match this condition.

n_installment_days_to_payment.title: Number of days between each payment
n_installment_days_to_payment.description: This field contains the number of days between each payment that will be applied for transactions that match this condition.

work_days.title: Work days flag
work_days.description: This flag indicates if the transaction will consider only work days when calculating the date of payment of the sale that match this condition.

transaction_fee.title: Transaction fee
transaction_fee.description: Is the fee applied in each transaction that use this condition.

matched_settlement.title: Matched settlement flag
matched_settlement.description: This flag indicates if the transaction will be splitted into different installments (true) or a single installment (false).

matched_mdr.title: Matched MDR flag
matched_mdr.description: This flag indicates if the transaction MDR will be splitted into different installments (true) or paid in a single installment (false).

card_not_present_allowed.title: Card not present allowed flag
card_not_present_allowed.description: Flag that indicates if it is possible to create a transaction without a card (true) or not (false)

doc_number_allowed.title: Document number allowed flag
doc_number_allowed.description: If true, is possible to create a transaction only using a document number.

merchant_id.title: The merchant identifier
merchant_id.description: This field identifies the merchant related to the operation.

start_date.title: The date when this condition becomes active
start_date.description: This field contains the date when this condition becomes active, used for creating campaigns.
